hints.title: Subarray Bitwise AND Monotonicity
hints.text: For a fixed ending index, extending the subarray leftward can only clear bits, resulting in at most 30 distinct bitwise bitwise and values.

hints.title: Frequency Map Propagation
hints.text: Maintain a frequency counter of active bitwise bitwise and values of subarrays ending at index i - 1.

hints.title: Target Accumulation
hints.text: Compute new bitwise bitwise and values by bitwise ANDing each previous value with nums[i]. Add the frequency of k to the running total.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter

class Solution:
    def countSubarrays(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        ans = 0
        prev = Counter()
        for x in nums:
            cur = Counter()
            cur[x] += 1
            for val, cnt in prev.items():
                cur[val & x] += cnt
            ans += cur[k]
            prev = cur
        return ans
```

variables: max A: maximum element in nums
complexity.notes: At most 30 distinct bitwise AND values maintained per index.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all n^2 subarrays causes quadratic timeout.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space as each dictionary holds at most 30 entries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Exploit the logarithmic bound on distinct bitwise AND values across subarray prefixes.
